incident_spec.summary: Investigating performance implications and concurrency behavior of large transactions in PostgreSQL.
symptoms: Blocked transactions due to row-level locks.
Potential serialization errors in higher isolation levels.
incident_spec.mechanism: PostgreSQL's MVCC model and transaction isolation levels dictate how reads and writes interact during large transactions.

value.description: PostgreSQL uses Multiversion Concurrency Control (MVCC) to ensure data consistency.

facts.evidence: PostgreSQL documentation cited in the DBA post.

value.description: Higher isolation levels may lead to serialization errors.

facts.evidence: PostgreSQL documentation cited in the DBA post.

value.description: Transactions attempting to update rows locked by another transaction are blocked until the lock is released.

facts.evidence: Example provided in the DBA post.

assumptions: The target database uses PostgreSQL 9.3 or a compatible version.
The synthetic data will mimic the row-level locking behavior observed in the example.
unknowns: Exact schema and data distribution of the production environment.
Specific workload patterns that trigger blocking or serialization errors.

feasibility.rationale: PostgreSQL adapter is available, and the incident mechanism can be reproduced using synthetic data. However, the target database does not exist, requiring setup.

schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tools (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, description TEXT);
generation_sql: INSERT INTO tools (description) SELECT CONCAT('tool_', n) FROM generate_series(1, {row_count}) AS n;

tables.name: tools
tables.purpose: Primary table for simulating row-level locking and transaction behavior.
tables.distribution_notes: Uniform distribution of rows with unique descriptions.

calibration_queries.objective: Verify that reads are not blocked by the update transaction.
expected_evidence: Query returns the old value of the row until the transaction commits.

queries: BEGIN; UPDATE tools SET description = 'updated_tool' WHERE id = 1; COMMIT;
BEGIN; UPDATE tools SET description = 'another_update' WHERE id = 1; COMMIT;

validation_criteria: Reads are not blocked by updates.
symptom_evidence: Blocked transactions due to row-level locks.
Serialization errors in higher isolation levels.
mechanism_evidence: Transaction isolation levels dictate blocking and serialization behavior.
